findings.justification: E4 shows the operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 was 41% (shown in the 'Total' column). This is stated as a historical result for fiscal year 2025. Since 41% exceeds 40%, this entails the assertion.

E4 shows the operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 was 41% (0.41 as a ratio). This is stated as a historical result for fiscal year 2025. Since 0.41 > 0.4, this entails the numeric assertion.

E7 shows operating income of $83,276 million for 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, and E8 shows revenue of $200,966 million for the same period. Operating margin = 83,276 / 200,966 = 0.4144 or 41.44%, which exceeds 40%. These are XBRL facts for the exact period.
